title: Homiliae in Psalmos (31 Psalm homilies) / «Беседы на Псалмы» Астерия Софиста (Псевдо-Астерия)
author: Asterius the Sophist, or an anonymous Antiochene ('Ps.-Asterius', per Kinzig)
edition: M. Richard, Asterii Sophistae commentariorum in Psalmos quae supersunt (Oslo 1956). German: Kinzig, BGL 56 (Hiersemann 2002).
ru_evidence: azbyka.ru (under Asterius of Amasea, the PG 40 ascription) has 5 homilies on Ps 5 and one each on Ps 6–7; most likely from this corpus, so c. 7 of 31
en_evidence: Open Library returns only the German translation (Kinzig 2002); en.wikipedia lists no translation
value: The earliest Greek homiletic cycle on the Psalms after Origen: vivid Easter-week preaching, catechumens, liturgy, Arian-era theology, striking rhetorical imagery. For historians of liturgy, preaching and Antioch.
ai_feasibility: medium-high: rhetorical Greek with puns and antitheses; the authorship debate needs commentary.
pilot_unit: Homilies not yet in Russian (e.g. on Ps 1–4); est. 12–15k words
